world_read.summary: A constructed car-interior collage on a flat blue-gray field. A wide black-rimmed rearview mirror holds cropped dark hair, a cheek, a suited torso and a narrow red cartoon-car face. Two hanging white dice overlap the glass. A steering-wheel arc and cigar-holding hand fill the lower left, with smoke rising toward the mirror. A tall phone-like slab at right contains angular yellow-and-blue shapes on green. The mirror is the single planned source-bearing anchor.
